threshold_audit.issue_identified: Original report contained 'Optimal Test Cost' column generated by running evaluate_cost_curve directly on test labels (test-set threshold leakage).
threshold_audit.correction_applied: Modified pipeline to select optimal thresholds strictly on VALIDATION data (argmin validation cost), freeze that threshold, and apply it unchanged to the TEST data.
threshold_audit.naming_correction: Renamed metric to 'Validation-selected operating point' and 'Test Cost at Validation-Selected Operating Point'. Removed all 'Optimal Test Cost' claims.

calibration_audit.test_usage: Calibrator is applied unchanged to test predictions without refitting or access to test labels.

oof_meta_learner_audit.holdout_leakage_check: Every training row was predicted by a base model trained on 4/5 of the data where that row was excluded from training.
oof_meta_learner_audit.test_meta_training_leakage_check: Zero test rows were used in base model OOF training or in meta-learner fitting.

graph_temporal_audit.finding: Target mapping and cached embedding lookups are verified correct. Standalone PR-AUC of 0.1859 is a genuine reflection of static bipartite graph limitations on future temporal windows where novel entities have zero prior edges.

autoencoder_zero_day_audit.original_issue: 95th percentile specificity threshold was previously selected using legitimate transactions from the test split.
autoencoder_zero_day_audit.correction_applied: Threshold selected strictly on Validation legitimate transactions (N=9,225, threshold=0.3418), frozen, and evaluated on Test novel patterns.
